409.description: The write conflicts with the state of a resource. Problem types: `seller-exists`, `seller-suspended` (`ErrSellerSuspended`), `node-cannot-receive` (`ErrNodeCannotReceive`), `sscc-not-unique` (`ErrSsccNotUnique`), `shipment-not-labelled` (`ErrShipmentNotLabelled`), `illegal-transition` and `concurrent-update` (optimistic-concurrency conflict; re-read and retry).

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `sscc-not-unique`.

detail.example: sscc not unique: 006141420000000011 is already in this shipment

422.description: The request is malformed or breaks a rule. Problem types: `validation-failed`, `case-pack-not-uniform` (`ErrCasePackNotUniform`), `case-qty-mismatches-gtin` (`ErrCaseQtyMismatchesGtin`), `carton-overweight` (`ErrCartonOverweight`), `carton-oversize` (`ErrCartonOversize`), `invalid-sscc` (`ErrInvalidSscc`), `carton-contents-mismatch-plan` (`ErrCartonContentsMismatchPlan`), `idempotency-key-required` and `idempotency-key-reused`.

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `sscc-not-unique`.

detail.example: sscc not unique: 006141420000000011 is already in this shipment
